name: Jeffries Manufacturing LLC
old_description: I started this company in 2021 with a vision to create high-quality, reliable products that businesses and consumers could depend on. Jeffries Manufacturing LLC was founded on excellent craftsmanship, efficiency, and the use of cutting-edge technology.
about:
Jeffries Manufacturing LLC operates from Charlton Heights, West Virginia, where Randall Jeffries founded the company in 2021. Jeffries, drawing on nearly three decades of personal welding and fabrication experience, identified a market gap for precision-crafted frame plates for first-generation Toyota Tundra trucks and launched the business to fill it. The venture began with a focus on American-made durability and innovation.

The company produces a line of proprietary products including bolt-in frame supports for Tundra pickups, lower housing guards for Mercury, Evinrude, Honda, and Yamaha outboard motors, a patented propeller guard developed for high-water rescue, and the J-Stop™ anti-pest garage door bracket. In addition to its own product line, Jeffries Manufacturing provides a full suite of metal fabrication and welding services—MIG, TIG, arc, aluminum, stainless steel, flux-cored, and structural welding—along with sheet metal design, equipment and machinery repair, heavy equipment and truck frame repair, and Caterpillar excavator implement installations, hydraulic hammer rebuilds, and quick coupler installations.

Customers span marine, automotive, fire and rescue, heavy equipment, and pest control sectors. The Glasgow Fire Department partners with the firm for its patented propeller guard used in high-water rescue operations. The company also serves truck owners needing frame reinforcement, boaters requiring lower unit protection, and construction firms needing CAT excavator maintenance. Jeffries Manufacturing emphasizes local sourcing, purchasing steel from West Virginia vendors and supporting community projects.

The company differentiates itself as the sole manufacturer of its Tundra frame plate design and holds a patent on its rescue propeller guard. Its foundation rests on Jeffries’ 29-plus years of welding expertise, a commitment to safety and creative problem solving, and a business model built on reliable service and respect for clients.
